sources.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: The Developer Guide- Google Developers Blog
sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma 2 is designed to provide a single, compact open model released under the Apache 2.0 license, delivering exceptional multimodal performance for its size. Based on Gemma 4, this sub-1B model maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional space.
